description: We are enthusiast students who are super curious to learn
summary: We have developed a project which introduces young space enthusiasts and explorers aged 5-10 to real space-robots like Lunokhod-1, Yutu-2, Sojourner, Sprit & Opportunity, and Perseverance. Our projects enables kids to discover how these clever rovers drive across different surfaces like that of the moon and mars, to snap cool pictures, search for ancient water, and unlock secrets of the other world.
details: Our project allows young children to visualise and explore rovers which contributed to the history of space exploration. We used open-source tools such as GODOT, to create a basic prototype of our finished product, along with a fully-developed slideshow that contains the basic plan of our project. Coding language used is python on GODOT, cleverly done by the youngest one in our team. We considered factors involving children-hooking user interfaces, such as bright visuals, 3D perspectives, and engaging facts. Target audience: 5-10 years.
